{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Designer In-Spire
| Image = Event-Designer.png
}}
{{E|Designer In-Spire}} is a {{QueryLink|Events|shrine:Yes|shrine Event}} found in [[Act 2]] and [[Act 3]]. It will only appear if the player has at least 75 [[Gold]].

== Options ==
{{Frame|Adjustments}} {{TS|negative||Lose 40}} {{asc|15|(50)}} [[Gold]]{{TS|negative||.}} {{TS|positive||One of the following rewards appears.}}
* {{TS|positive||[[Upgrade]] a card.}}
* {{TS|positive||[[Upgrade]] two random cards.}}
<br>
{{Frame|Clean Up}} {{TS|negative||Lose 60}} {{asc|15|(75)}} [[Gold]]{{TS|negative||.}} {{TS|positive||One of the following rewards appears.}}
* {{TS|positive||Remove a card.}}
* {{TS|positive||[[Transform]] two cards.}}
<br>
{{Frame|Full Service}} {{TS|negative||Lose 90}} {{asc|15|(110)}} [[Gold]]{{TS|negative||.}}  {{TS|positive||Remove a card, then [[upgrade]] a random card.}}
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|Punch}} {{TS|negative||Lose 3}} {{asc|15|(5)}} {{TS|negative||HP.}}

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You discover a {{TS|green|up|colorful}} shop with the banner "IN-SPIRE" and walk in to see what's inside.<br>
"No, no way. Nope. Can't let you in!" <br>

A man with ridiculous clothing appears at the entrance to bar you.
</div><br><br>

{{Frame|Continue}}
<br>
<br>
<div style="font-style:italic">
"This will not do, no no. What is this style? {{TS||shake|Disgusting!}} Are you {{TS|negative||bleeeeding?}} {{TS|purple|up|Groooss.}} {{TS||shake|Business??}} You a customer? Fine. {{TS||up|Whaaatever."}} <br>
He lets out an exaggerated sigh and points at a list of services. <br>

The services seem fine, but you would rather punch this smug man in his smug face.
</div><br><br>

{{Frame|Adjustments}}, {{Frame|Clean Up}}, and {{Frame|Full Service}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"Okay, bye bye now." <br>

...should've punched him.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Punch}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You punch him so hard your fist hurts. <br>
"My {{TS||shake|FACE!!}} Now I'll have to-" <br>

He fainted. Who's {{TS|purple|up|groooss}} and {{TS|negative||bleeeeding}} now?
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Trivia ==
* This event is internally called <code>Designer</code>.
* If {{Frame|Punch}} is chosen, the Designer's portrait will change. This is the only [[Events|Event]] that changes its portrait.

</div>

* '''Patch V2.0: The Watcher'''
** The Designer event's options are now seeded.
